verdict.rationale: Conta Simples publishes a REST API with OAuth 2.0 client credentials, an interactive playground, and Markdown/llms.txt docs, so an official SDK is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence mentions any official client library or SDK in any language. A REST API, playground, and LLM-readable docs are adjacent building blocks, not SDKs, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so no published spec for generated clients was found either.
